notes: Cash basis school district (FY ended 8/31/2025). Governmental funds only (no enterprise funds; School Nutrition Fund is shown within governmental funds). Receipts, disbursements and balances come from the Total Governmental Funds column of the Statement of Receipts, Disbursements and Changes in Fund Balances (pp5-6), where interfund transfers (721,084) and interfund loan repayment (50,558) are already eliminated by the Reclassifications column; so transfers_in/out are null. Beginning cash is the printed total beginning fund balance 6,079,102 (p6); ending 7,154,880 ties to the net position statement (p2). Other Support Services 610,501 split into Depreciation Fund 26,250 (support services) and Activities Fund 584,251 (student activities) by fund column on p6. Detail: General Fund schedule by function (no object breakdown, so not itemized); the 500,000 transferred from the General Fund to the Depreciation Fund is hidden in General Fund lines 1100 Regular Instruction (200,000) and 2620 Maintenance of Buildings (300,000) per the p6 reclassification column, split out as other financing. General Fund 8000 Transfers 221,084 (to Activities 211,084 and Nutrition 10,000) as other financing. Interfund loan repayment 50,558 recorded as other financing in General (+) and QCPU (-). Activities Fund detail is account by account (receipts and disbursements columns); the transfers in/(out) column (nets to zero) and balances are not recorded. Printed budget amounts appear only on fund totals, so budget_final is omitted on lines. Balance sheet is the cash basis Statement of Net Position (p2); no liabilities. No printed discrepancies noted. Trimmed p1 (report table of contents, added by the v8 re-trim) holds no data. Read pages 1-14 of 14
